packageRules.description: Major chart bumps often carry breaking values changes — never automerge, flag loudly
kubectl (utils/Dockerfile, the system-upgrade Job image) tracks the cluster's k3s minor — only patch bumps automatically, minors are bumped by hand together with the k3s version

k3s moves one minor at a time (Kubernetes does not support skipping one) and merging the PR upgrades every node in the next maintenance window — one PR per minor, minors gated behind the dashboard, and a week of soak for re-spun releases
prBodyNotes: Merging upgrades every node in the next system-upgrade window (immediately if merged during one): control-plane nodes one at a time, then the agents.
- [ ] every chart deployed on the cluster supports the new Kubernetes minor
- [ ] bump by hand `KUBECTL_VERSION` in `utils/Dockerfile` and `controller.job.kubectlImage` in `argo-cd/apps/system-upgrade/values.yaml` to the same minor

packageRules.description: SonarQube server, its Community Build number and the community-branch-plugin are version-locked upstream (plugin X.Y.Z only supports Community Build X.Y.Z.*) — they move as one reviewed change, gated behind the dashboard so a server bump can never land ahead of a plugin release
prBodyNotes: - [ ] a [community-branch-plugin](https://github.com/mc1arke/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin/releases) release exists for this Community Build, and its `X.Y.Z` matches `community.buildNumber` in all 5 places (install URL, jar filename, `jvmOpts`, `jvmCeOpts`, webapp zip URL)
- [ ] [sonar-auth-oidc](https://github.com/sonar-auth-oidc/sonar-auth-oidc/releases) still declares this server version as supported
- [ ] [sonar-cnes-report](https://github.com/cnescatlab/sonar-cnes-report/releases) still declares this server version as supported

packageRules.description: SonarQube plugins that version independently of the server — each release pins a supported server range, so read the notes before merging
prBodyNotes: Check the release notes declare the running SonarQube version as supported before merging.

packageRules.description: sonar-auth-oidc tags are `v`-prefixed but its jar filename is not, so the two occurrences extract as separate deps — group them to keep both edits in one PR

CNPG ClusterImageCatalog holds one entry per Postgres major — a major moves by adding an entry and bumping the app's `version.postgresql` (in-place pg_upgrade), never by rewriting an existing entry; minor/patch bumps of every entry ride one PR since they roll every cluster anyway

The ClusterImageCatalog images are tracked by the custom regex manager below, whose versioning understands their build-timestamp tags; the built-in helm-values manager extracts the same `image:` strings a second time with docker versioning, which sees the timestamp as an incompatible suffix and only adds a duplicate dependency

Everything under argo-cd/apps (the catalog) and utils/helm (the bootstrap chart) is released by release-please: a dependency bump there is a releasable fix, so it is included in the next release of that part (chore commits are never released)
A major bump of a chart dependency often carries breaking values changes: release it as a minor of the catalog or the chart (pre-1.0, a minor is the breaking level)

customManagers.description: Pinned tool versions in utils/Dockerfile ARGs
k3s version: ansible pins (inventory example, real inventory, role default) and the in-cluster system-upgrade Plan version per instance — bumped together
kubectl image of the system-upgrade Jobs (cordon/drain init containers)
Gateway API CRD bundle applied by run.sh
Custom ARM64 mattermost image (upstream has no official arm64 build) — tracked independently of the chart's helmv3 bump since the chart's appVersion/digest targets amd64 only

SonarQube Community Build number — the helmv3 bump only moves the chart, the running server version lives in `community.buildNumber` (image tag `<buildNumber>-community`) and is mirrored in our own appVersion
sonarqube-community-branch-plugin — the version appears in the release URL, the jar filename (install list plus both javaagent opts) and the webapp zip URL; all of them must carry the same value
sonar-auth-oidc plugin (project moved from the vaulttec org, which the GitHub API does not redirect)

Postgres images in the shared CNPG ClusterImageCatalog — tags carry a build timestamp, which the default docker versioning treats as an incompatible suffix, so it is parsed as the patch component instead
Pinned ohmlab bootstrap chart (the registry catalog entry) in each instance's core.yaml; merging the bump is what updates the self-managed Argo CD
Pinned catalog bundle (an `oci://` catalog entry) in each instance's instance.yaml; merging the bump moves every entry of the instance that takes its chart from the bundle
